basic_details.job_title: PRL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Purchase & Stores Officer

application_fee.details: The application fee is ₹250 for all posts. Initially, all applicants - including those from fee-exempt categories (Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) - must uniformly pay ₹750 as application fee. Candidates from fee-exemption categories (Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) will get a full refund of the application fee if they attend the written test. UR/EWS/OBC candidates will get a refund of ₹500 if they attend the written test. The application fee will not be refunded to candidates who fail to attend the written test. Correct bank account details with IFSC code must be furnished while filling the online application in order to receive the refund. All fee-exempted categories except women must upload the relevant certificate (SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) to get the refund. Payment can be made online via Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, either immediately after submission or any day before 24.08.2026.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 24.08.2026 . Age relaxation is applicable as follows: | OBC candidates: up to 38 years (wherever posts are reserved) SC candidates: up to 40 years (wherever posts are reserved) Serving government employees, Ex-Servicemen, and Persons with Disabilities are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India orders.

qualification.details: Key eligibility notes: | Graduation/Post-Graduation (other than MBA/ACA/FCA/FICWA/AICWA/PG Diploma in Materials Management) must be First Class with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA of 6.3 on a 10-point scale. Only candidates with MBA in the specific stream mentioned for each post (HR for Administrative Officer, Finance/Banking Public Systems Management for Accounts Officer, Marketing/Materials Management for Purchase & Stores Officer) are eligible to apply. Experience must be obtained only after acquiring the essential educational qualification, and must be in the relevant field (Administration / Accounts & Finance / Purchase & Stores) in a government office, public body, or a reputed commercial organisation. Wherever supervisory experience is required, it must be at least at Level 6 (₹35,400-₹1,12,400) of the Pay Matrix or equivalent (E1 grade in IDA scale for PSU employees, or basic pay of at least ₹35,400 for those in a reputed commercial organisation). Candidates should possess good communication skills, leadership qualities, and familiarity with computers. | The upper age limit is 35 years as on 24.08.2026. Age relaxation is applicable as follows: | OBC candidates: up to 38 years (wherever posts are reserved) SC candidates: up to 40 years (wherever posts are reserved) Serving government employees, Ex-Servicemen, and Persons with Disabilities are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India orders. | Only persons suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for age relaxation. Candidates availing age relaxation must submit a Disability Certificate in the prescribed format at the time of interview, issued by a Medical Board of at least three members (one being a specialist in the relevant field), duly constituted by the Central or State Government.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be appointed as Officers in Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100 per month. In addition, the following are payable/admissible as per extant rules: | Dearness Allowance (DA) House Rent Allowance (HRA) Transport Allowance National Pension System (NPS) coverage Contributory Health Service Scheme for self and dependent family members Canteen facility Limited quarters facility (in lieu of HRA) Departmental transport facility (in lieu of transport allowance) Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Group Insurance

selection_process: Part A Objective (MCQ) General Studies, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning 36 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong
Part B Objective (MCQ) English Grammar (Graduation level) 32 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong
Part C Objective (MCQ) Post-specific specialised subject (see below) 36 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong
Part D Descriptive Precis writing, Essay writing, Comprehension, Letter writing 2 10 marks per question
Selection is through a Written Test followed by an Interview.
The written test will be conducted only at Ahmedabad (PRL reserves the right to change the venue). To qualify the written test
candidates must secure at least 40% marks in each part of the objective-type test and a minimum aggregate of 50% in the objective test

plus a minimum of 50% marks in the descriptive-type test. Part D (descriptive) will be evaluated manually only for candidates who have qualified in the other three parts. Based on written test performance

candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a ratio of 1:5 (minimum 10 candidates) against the category-wise number of vacancies. Qualifying the written test alone does not guarantee an interview call. Weightage: Written test - 60%
Interview - 40%. Final empanelment: candidates must secure a minimum of 50% marks each in the written test and interview
with an overall aggregate of at least 60%

considered in order of merit. The written test is of 2 hours 30 minutes duration. PwBD candidates eligible for a scribe/reader get 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour of examination. PwBD candidates must arrange their own scribe/reader (qualification one step below the minimum required for the post) and submit the required declarations (Appendix II and Appendix III) at least 7 days before the exam date. PRL does not provide a scribe/reader.
Part C specialised subjects by post:
Administrative Officer: Constitution of India (including reservations in government service)
and basic HR management principles (organisation behaviour
training and development). Accounts Officer: Principles of Auditing
and Basics of Economics. Purchase & Stores Officer: Material Management
Import and Export Policy and Procedures
Capital Budgeting and relevant Mercantile Acts.

syllabus.details: Part Type Coverage Questions Marking Part A Objective (MCQ) General Studies, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning 36 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong Part B Objective (MCQ) English Grammar (Graduation level) 32 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong Part C Objective (MCQ) Post-specific specialised subject (see below) 36 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong Part D Descriptive Precis writing, Essay writing, Comprehension, Letter writing 2 10 marks per question | Part C specialised subjects by post: | Administrative Officer: Constitution of India (including reservations in government service), Industrial Disputes Act, Workmen's Compensation Act, Contract Labour Regulation Act, Apprentices Act, Right to Information Act, Minimum Wages Act, and basic HR management principles (organisation behaviour, motivation, leadership, training and development). Accounts Officer: Principles of Auditing, Costing, Balance Sheet reading, Ratio analysis, Auditing, Management Accountancy, Mercantile Law, Banking Practices, Taxation, and Basics of Economics. Purchase & Stores Officer: Material Management, Import and Export Policy and Procedures, Duties and Taxes (Central and State), Inventory Management, Contract Act, Sale of Goods Act, E-procurement, Capital Budgeting and relevant Mercantile Acts.

how_to_apply: Register online between 25.07.2026 and 24.08.2026, selecting only one post (Administrative Officer OR Accounts Officer OR Purchase & Stores Officer).
Fill in a valid email ID; all future correspondence regarding the written test, interview, etc. will be through email and the website only.
Upload the required scanned documents, photograph, and signature as per the specified guidelines.
Pay the application fee of ₹750 (uniform for all categories) online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, either immediately or any day before 24.08.2026.
After registration, note down and safely preserve the Registration Number provided for future reference.
Check all details carefully before final submission; avoid submitting multiple applications for the same post.

content_sections.heading: PRL Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Before starting the online application, candidates should keep the following ready: Valid email ID and mobile number Documentary proof of date of birth (Matriculation/10th/SSLC certificate) Scanned copy of final/provisional certificate and marksheet for Graduation/Post Graduation/MBA/PG Diploma/Conversion Certificate, as applicable Scanned copy of caste certificate, if applicable (100 KB, PDF format) Scanned copy of PwBD certificate, if applicable (100 KB, PDF format) Scanned copy of discharge certificate for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable (100 KB, PDF format) Recent passport-size colour photograph (100 KB, JPEG/JPG, not older than 3 months): no selfies, full face frontal view visible, plain/white background, not black-and-white, height and width should be equal Scanned signature (100 KB, JPEG/JPG) with an aspect ratio of 7:2

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application and paying the application fee is 24.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies in total: 1 for Administrative Officer, 2 for Accounts Officer, and 2 for Purchase & Stores Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹250, but all candidates must initially pay ₹750; eligible fee-exempt categories and general candidates get partial or full refunds if they attend the written test.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 24.08.2026, with relaxation to 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC candidates, wherever posts are reserved.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for PRL Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer and Purchase & Stores Officer?
faq.answer: All three posts carry a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100 per month in Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500) of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, along with DA, HRA, Transport Allowance and other benefits.

faq.question: Q6. Can a candidate apply for more than one post in PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one post - either Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, or Purchase & Stores Officer.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for PRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection consists of a Written Test (60% weightage) followed by an Interview (40% weightage), with minimum qualifying marks required in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the PRL Recruitment 2026 online application?
faq.answer: Candidates need a valid email/mobile number, date of birth proof, educational certificates and marksheets, caste/PwBD/Ex-Serviceman certificates (if applicable), a recent passport-size photograph, and a scanned signature, as detailed in the Required Documents section above.
